labels.text: section 4941(a)(2): 5 percent of the amount involved, per year (or part thereof) in the taxable period, paid by a knowing/willful foundation manager who participated

5 percent, raised from 2.5 percent by Pub. L. 109-280 (Pension Protection Act of 2006) section 1212(f), applicable to taxable years beginning after August 17, 2006 (the enactment date) per the pinned note IRC_S4941_NOTE_6. The pre-2006 2.5 percent rate for a taxable year beginning before that date is NOT modelled (SOURCE_GAP for that period).
